title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: dangerous-goods share kept collectible when a late line is cleared
content:
## Scope

This rule of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category fixes the amount of the late-invoice waiver on a demurrage invoice line of a per-container record, where the container's booking may carry dangerous goods.

## Rule

1. The amount still open on the late line is cleared except its dangerous-goods uplift share, which the line passes through to the terminal and which stays collectible.
2. When the booking's cargo type is dangerous goods, the uplift share is the amount still open multiplied by the product's dangerous-goods uplift percentage and divided by the sum of 100 and that percentage; otherwise the uplift share is nothing.
3. The waiver is the amount still open less the uplift share, rounded to the nearest cent only at the end.

## Worked example (hypothetical amount still open of USD 840.00 and an illustrative uplift of 40 percent)

| Booking | Uplift share kept collectible | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| dangerous goods | USD 840.00 multiplied by 40 and divided by 140, that is USD 240.00 | USD 600.00 |
| not dangerous goods | nothing | USD 840.00 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| "A late line is wiped out in full, uplift included." | The uplift share stays collectible on a dangerous-goods booking. |
| "Keep 40 percent of the open amount." | The share is the uplift percentage divided by 100 plus that percentage, applied to the amount still open: USD 240.00, not USD 336.00. |
